title: 06_cCRE/clump_regions_100kb pipeline parameters
description: Per-phenotype-group 100kb-padded GWAS clump regions, from 04_gwas/1_mlma-loco's and 04_gwas/2_polmm's clumping output.

mlma_dir.description: 04_gwas/1_mlma-loco's published gwas/ output directory (*_LOCO.loco.mlma, all 4 phenotypes) — used to look up secondary SNPs' own BP positions (plink's .clumped file only gives these by SNP ID, not position).

polmm_clumping_dir.description: 04_gwas/2_polmm's published clumping/ output directory (polmmCCDitem<id>_clump250.clumped, all 14 items) — pooled into the "dogCD" region set alongside F1/F2/F3.

polmm_gwas_dir.description: 04_gwas/2_polmm's published gwas/ output directory (modi_simuMarkerOutput_POLMM_item<id>_FULLGRM_fullGeno.txt, all 14 items) — used the same way as mlma_dir, to look up secondary SNPs' own BP positions.
